title: Rosemary Spiced Nuts
description: Mixed nuts roasted with butter, rosemary, and cayenne, tossed while still hot so the seasoning sticks. Twelve servings, gone in twenty minutes.
notes: Keeps two weeks airtight, and re-crisps in a low oven for five minutes if it softens.

steps.text: Spread the mixed nuts on a tray and roast until they smell toasted and have taken a little colour.
steps.tip: Shake the tray halfway. Nuts go from perfect to burnt in about ninety seconds.

steps.text: Combine the melted butter, rosemary, brown sugar, salt, and cayenne in a large bowl.
Tip the hot nuts straight into the bowl and toss until every one is coated.
steps.tip: Hot is doing the work here — the rosemary fries slightly against the nuts and the sugar just melts.

steps.text: Spread back out to cool and crisp before serving.
